messages:
maria_ng: Heads up — noticed p95/p99 lines dropped off the latency dashboard for prod/payment-service right after the 22:00 deploy. p50 still shows.

samir_ops: saw that too. thanks for flagging. is this only payments?

maria_ng: checked org and service views. payments + billing are affected. frontend and ingestion look normal.

jia_support: customer pinged about increased visible latency but no tails on graphs — they think charts are lying. assigned to support. @olga_support_lead FYI :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026-03-15-22:00 (rev: a1b2c3). Canary -> prod.

samir_ops: could be telemetry relabeling or aggregator change in the deploy. tom_metrics any idea?

tom_metrics: I'll pull the raw series. first quick check: p50 series tag set present, but p95/p99 series look absent at ingestion layer.

tom_metrics: running query against raw metrics (promql):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service, env))
```
returns empty for those services; buckets present for p50.

maria_ng: interesting — buckets exist but quantile eval empty. could be relabel removed high-latency buckets?

samir_ops: any change to histogram bucket boundaries in the release?

tom_metrics: checking git diff for metrics schema. I see a tiny change in telemetry-agent config: it now drops buckets with label latency_level=high.

jia_support: who owns that change? the agent config was in infra repo under `telemetry/agent/defaults.yaml`?

tom_metrics: yep. commit 9f8e7d changed relabel rules.

olga_support_lead: if high buckets are being dropped, histogram_quantile can't compute p95/p99 — that explains missing lines.

maria_ng: any way to confirm quickly? can we re-run quantile against raw buckets by bypassing relabel?

tom_metrics: I ran curl to the exporter on a node and fetched /metrics. The high 'le' buckets are present at the exporter. The relabel step in the telemetry-agent has a rule: `- action: drop
  source_labels: ["latency_level"]
  regex: "high"` added in the deploy. so exporter -> agent -> aggregator; agent is removing them.

samir_ops: rollback plan? we should revert the relabel change in agent and redeploy the agent config ASAP.

olga_support_lead: prioritize this. customers see missing SLA curves. Olga -> please coordinate rollback and communication to impacted tenants.

tom_metrics: creating patch to remove the drop rule, will push to canary telemetry first.

deploy-bot: Patch PR opened: infra/telemetry#402 (remove high bucket drop).

maria_ng: can we backfill p95/p99 on the dashboard while agent rolls out? some dashboards compute quantiles client-side from stored buckets — if buckets were dropped they won't be recoverable unless we re-ingest.

tom_metrics: buckets exist on node exporters for now, but they haven't been forwarded since agent drop. we can instruct agents to re-pull last 15m window via agent restart to send queued metrics, but there's no historical store for missing windows. short-term: after rollback and restart, new data will populate; older missing points won't be backfilled.

jia_support: suggested customer message: "We've identified a telemetry agent regressor in a recent infra deploy that dropped high-latency histogram buckets used to compute p95/p99. We're rolling back the change now; metrics should return within minutes after agent restarts. No user traffic impacted. We're monitoring and will follow up."

olga_support_lead: +1. send to customers in affected orgs (billing, payments). include ETA ~15-45m.

samir_ops: action items: 1) rollback telemetry relabel (tom) 2) restart agents on affected nodes (infra oncall) 3) monitor quantile series populate (tom + samir) 4) update customers (jia).

tom_metrics: rolled patch to canary at 23:05. canary agents restarted, quantiles returned for canary services. Rolling to prod now.

maria_ng: confirmed prod payment-service p95 line reappearing on dashboard at ~23:22. p99 still a bit sparse but coming back.

deploy-bot: Agent rollout progress: 62% -> 85% -> 100% (23:24).

tom_metrics: after full rollout, dashboards show p50/p95/p99 for the previously affected services. I've removed the drop rule from the default config.

jia_support: customer update sent at 23:30: "Issue resolved — telemetry agent relabel reverted, percentile lines restored. We'll post a root cause summary tomorrow."

olga_support_lead: please draft RCA and include: root cause (bad relabel rule), impact (missing p95/p99 for ~40m for payments/billing dashboards), mitigation (rollback + agent restart), follow-up actions (add test for telemetry relabels in CI, require staging rollout for agent config changes).

samir_ops: adding a ticket to infra backlog for automated histogram-presence tests. #infra-telemetry

maria_ng: thanks everyone. closing thread once RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
